pages.title: Let's Plow
pages.text: Race 2: Denver, 4.5 miles, the shortest race. Password: BRONCOS. Here the cars do not keep to one side of the road, warns the game, so keep an eye on the rear-view mirror. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Roller Rash
pages.text: Early in 1994 a reader asked Mean Machines Sega when Road Rash III: Roller Rash was due. The answer: it's called Skitchin and is out in March. It ran on the Road Rash II engine.

pages.title: How hard?
pages.text: Before each race the TV host sizes up the course, from 'a cake walk' and 'easy, even for Handbags' to 'a donor skate' and 'the pinnacle of pain'.
